Align the left gripper vertically above the gold vehicle using the current head and wrist views; keep fingers open.
Lower a short distance onto the first vehicle and close the left gripper; retention will be checked visually on lifting.

Close the left gripper around the staged watch and test retention with a vertical lift.

Withdraw with open fingers so the fourth phone can settle, then approach the final black camera from above.

Adjust slightly toward the camera center, lower around its sides, close, and make a short retention test lift.

Carry the visibly retained camera fully over the basket interior, keeping the grip closed until the fifth placement is aligned.
Lower and release the camera fifth inside the basket, then lift clear with the gripper open before returning both arms to origin.

Complete the gradual return to both original EE poses with open grippers; leave all basket contents undisturbed.
